newsitem.title: USA: Brandywine Realty buys $41.625 mln portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Brandywine Realty buys $41.625 mln portfolio.

text.p: Brandywine Realty Trust said Tuesday it has bought a 10-property commercial real estate portfolio for $41.625 million.
The company said the 687,500-square-foot portfolio, which consists of office and flex/warehouse space, includes:
-- Spring House Corporate Center, a two-building, 139,467-square-foot office complex in Lower Gwynedd Township, Pa. The property is 100 percent leased.
-- Oxford Corporate Center, a three-building, 115,390-square-foot, flex/warehouse property in Langhorne, Pa. The property is 93.4 percent occupied.

-- Highlands Business Park, a four-building, 388,767-square-foot, flex/warehouse property in Westhampton, N.J. The property is 97 percent leased. Seven undeveloped parcels covering 30 acres are also included, allowing for 300,000 square feet of flex/warehouse space development.
-- Greentree Commons, a 43,710-square-foot, single-story garden office complex in Evesham Township, N.J. The property is 89 percent occupied.
Brandywine owns 66 commercial and industrial properties containing more than 3.6 million rentable square feet in the Delaware Valley region, it said.
